name: Sprout Tower Monk Stealth Trial
summary: Arrive in historic Violet City and ascend the sacred Sprout Tower pagoda on the northern perimeter. Navigate a multi-floor stealth obstacle course across 2F to 6F: evade the vision cones of pacing monks, dodge wandering Bellsprouts, leap over floor pitfalls past dashing Weepinbells, and thread through a circular perimeter of Victreebels. Reach the top-floor altar to claim the vital Golbat Boot key item for Ice Mountain climbing, but leave the four sacred Bellsprout Statues undisturbed to avoid a severe -5 Karma penalty per statue.

items.name: Golbat Boot
items.method: Crucial key item resting on the table at the back of Sprout Tower 6F, enabling ice climbing

items.name: Sun Stone
items.method: Found atop the tranquil waterfall pool east of the Sprout Tower entrance

items.name: Fresh Water
items.method: Handed out freely by the energetic greeter inside Violet Gym's foyer
